games.title: Parkour Warrior
games.shortDescription: An exciting parkour action game with challenging levels and spectacular moves
games.fullDescription: Parkour Warrior is an intense 3D parkour action game built with Godot Engine. Navigate through challenging levels, perform wall-running, ledge-grabbing, and other parkour techniques to overcome obstacles. Master the art of parkour and reach the finish line!

games.title: Upcoming Godot Projects
games.shortDescription: Exciting new 3D game projects coming soon
games.fullDescription: I'm currently working on some amazing new 3D game projects using Godot Engine. These are still in development, but I'll be sharing sneak peeks and devlogs regularly. Make sure to check back often for updates!

games.title: Game Jam Entries
games.fullDescription: A collection of fun experimental games and rapid prototypes from various game jams. These showcase creative ideas, quick innovation, and experimental game mechanics. Many of these are available to play right now!
